## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is independently revertible and leaves CI green
- [ ] Commit bodies explain the reasoning, not the diff
- [ ] Tests accompany the code they cover, in the same commit
- [ ] ADR added or updated, or explicitly not needed
- [ ] No new dependency added without justification in the commit body

## Infrastructure changes only

- [ ] `terraform plan` output attached
- [ ] Monthly cost impact estimated
- [ ] Rollback path described
